06 FAQ

Before you pay.

Is the Google Play account mine? +

Always. We work inside your Play Console with the access you grant. We never register or own the developer account on your behalf.

How long does the review take? +

Preparation takes 1–3 working days. Google review usually takes 1–7 days and is outside our control. Complex policies or appeals can take longer.

What if Google rejects the app? +

We read the rejection reason, fix the listing or build issue with you, and resubmit. Starter includes 1 resubmission, Pro includes 2, Skala is unlimited during the engagement.

Is the USD 25 developer fee included? +

No. Google charges that directly when the developer account is created. Our fee covers the release work only.

Can I choose the payment method? +

Yes. Checkout is powered by Duitku — virtual account, QRIS, e-wallet, and card channels appear based on what is active on our merchant account.

When do you start? +

As soon as the payment is confirmed. You will get an email and a WhatsApp message with the next steps and a shared checklist.
